verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own marketing says you can map projects across teams and track work in one place, with health status and target dates. It also offers a Roadmap that visualizes Epics and Objectives that connect individual projects to company goals, so a cross-project view is a native capability. The evidence is marketing-level only and never describes aggregated progress metrics or a dedicated portfolio dashboard. missing for 10: documented progress roll-up across projects (e.g., percent complete aggregation), in-depth portfolio/roadmap docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
Create goals, align teams, and connect individual projects to company objectives.
